fusions.name: Hurled at a Canter
fusions.desc: You hurl a stone at the first enemy in line, dealing 8 damage and knocking it 2 tiles back. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after each throw. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Knuckle Gallop
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target on all fours and slam the ground, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and stunning them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Drum the Ground
fusions.desc: Your attack speed rises 25% for 10 seconds, and up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles are pulled onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Remembered Slight
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a kick strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
